status: Cargo's detail spec: the bay with its sealed crates (the whole), one crate opening (the arrival), the report on the bay's door, and the rack the pods land in, handed to Pods. Wireframes 17-cargo-bay.svg to 17d-cargo-nav.svg. Fix 5 (boards/station-fix5-cargo-spec.md): the bay painted in every state, the door by contents, the plate on the door, the rack insert, cuts
note: Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. The stage is the frame's (0, 40, 1024, 522); the top bar and the bottom line are the frame's.
stateRule: bay: the whole, the crates sealed in the bay (or none). opening: from ✓ Open the bay until the last crate has opened, one crate at a time, input held (events.opening). report: from the last crate's end until the next press, then the bay (the shut door when it holds nothing, the waiting pods on the open bay when pods wait). A region with `inStates` exists only in those states

conditions.away: the Companion is not in the Caddy: no walk crates; the door is shut unless a sitting crate or a waiting pod is in the bay, and a ready sitting crate opens as docked
conditions.docked: the door follows what the bay holds (R2): one sealed crate per crate the Companion brought, at most three, or a waiting pod, with the door open; with nothing, the door is shut

bay.rule: R2: open when it holds a walk crate, a ready sitting crate or a waiting pod, and in the opening; shut when it holds nothing, and in the report; in the report the door is slices.report (GB-R6); each change a cut. The open bay is the painting, drawn 1:1; the door goes 1:1 over it. The back wall runs from y 64 to about 238, the floor from about 240 to 352, its lip to 356, the rim 8 px (measured; nothing is placed by them but the feet lines)

states.shut: the door: nothing held, or the report
states.open: the painting: a walk crate, a ready sitting crate or a waiting pod, and the opening

crates.order: walk crates left to right in the order they open, sitting crates after them; the places are fixed by n on the Dock frame (crates sliding in never re-centre)

shadow.when: from the frame its crate has landed; a crate still sliding casts none

crates.overflow: more than three crates (developer only): the first three in bayCrates order show, walk crates first; no others are drawn; the context line counts all

sitting.places: after the walk crates, at the group's right end; at most three crates show, walk crates first

lamp.rule: under its crate, at (place.x + 122, 304) of its place by count: the rows lit from the bottom, floor(10 × crateLamp) in sky, the rest hairline; full only when ready

sitting.opens: a ready sitting crate opens in Cargo after the walk crates, in the same sequence, docked or away; its ribbon is strings.ribbon.sitting. It gets no row on the report; when only sitting crates opened, no report card shows and the bay shows at the end
sitting.revealNote: what the opened sitting crate shows (its portrait's reveal) is not designed yet (station-layouts.md, Not designed yet); until it is, a build leaves sitting crates out of the bay

waitingPods.order: st.waiting, oldest first; the context counts all
waitingPods.when: pods wait in the bay for a free well, in the bay state only; the mark leaves Cargo (it stays on Home's module)

pod.note: the collection class, as Pods' collection draws it, rendered at 88×112

rack.rule: the six places of the rack, the same pods in the same order as Pods' collection: an empty well, or its pod; a pod still travelling leaves its well empty until it lands; the wells are the insert's painting (an object, not an outline): the face draws no panel, rule or well

fit.w: words + 2 × pad, rounded up to 8, at least 160

ribbon.bound: the rect is the widest the ribbon may be; it shows only from 500 ms, 28 px above the closer's ink and 8 px above the pods' boxes

pods.more: pods numbered i from 0 in well order; 0, 1, 2 stand left, middle, right; pod i ≥ 3 appears in the middle place as a cut at 1200 + 150·(i−1) and travels from there at 1200 + 150·i; a pod with no free well stays and no later pod appears; developer crates only (play has at most 3)

shadow.offGrid: its core row 11 on the feet line 336

stores.show: a material's container only when this crate brought it: play.gained.k > 0 (state.mjs openBay, what the crate carried with the top-up, before any mend), the same figure as the report's Gathered row; the dock's mend is the Probe row's, never the containers'
stores.at: a cut at 800 ms with the counter tick, also with reduced motion; until the crate's end
stores.order: energy left of the closer, data then essence right of it, 8 px between rects; travelling pods draw over the containers
stores.rule: presentation only: no capacity, never kept (game designer 11:35)

travel.from: its place in the open crate
travel.path: a straight line, whole pixels, eased in and out; nothing is scaled; a pod never leaves this rectangle
travel.ease: in-out: p = min(1000, t·1000/600); e = p·p·(3000 − 2p)/1000000 (64-bit); pos = from + (to − from)·e/1000, integer division truncating toward zero; at p = 1000 exactly to

arrival.offGrid: the bay (16, 48, 992 × 320) and the apron (16, 368, 992 × 180) together, to y 548
arrival.rule: the Companion's dock as a show on the bay, then one choice: the bay (regions.bay, drawn as today), the apron in the rack's place for the show, the ribbon, the link light, the crates sliding in from the left, a glint on a crate holding a new species, the mibis who came home standing big on the apron, the Probe's plates and who leaves in the bay's top corners. At the show's end one cut: the apron gives way to the rack and the choice strip (panel.json form strip) stands over it. Every number is here; the times are ms from the dock

apron.note: drawn from the dither's end at 200 to the show's end, in the rack's place

light.rule: runs in from the bay's left edge: step k (0 to 3) shows the first (k + 1) × 244 px of the picture from 500 + 100 k ms, each a cut; whole from 800 on

crates.rule: crate i slides in from x −256 to its place over 400 ms in whole pixels from 500 + 333 i; its shadow shows from the frame it lands; more than three: the first three slide in and the strip's line counts all

glint.rule: at (crate x + 232, 128) from its crate's landing, on a crate holding a pod of a species new to the player: where, never what

hop.rule: the hatch's table (incubator.json events.hatch): [ms into the hop, px above the feet line], each a cut, whole pixels

mibis.layer: in front of the crates and their glints; carried order, left to right; a mibi without its painting shows its labelled placeholder at the same size
mibis.rule: mibi i (from 0) dithers in alone at 1600 + 500 i over 300 ms (16 levels, in place), then makes one hop; only one big picture changes per frame

probe.rule: one icon a whole plate, the whole ones first; at 2500 the mended ones turn whole one by one, 120 ms apart (a cut each); the words after the icons from the first mended one, none when none was mended

leaving.placeholder: a species without its face-{species}-24 shows a 24 × 24 stone plate with a mist edge (the register's placeholder); nothing is drawn in words instead
leaving.rule: right-aligned to x 984: the mark, then the faces of the mibis who leave with the Companion at this dock; with no one leaving, the corner is empty. Both groups sit beside the ribbon (208 to 816), never under it

arrival.ribbon: regions.ribbon, from 500 ms to the end: strings.arrival.ribbon, or strings.arrival.broken when nothing came back because the Probe broke

end.rule: the show's end, 3500 ms (at most 3600): one cut, counted as a screen change: the mibis are gone, the apron gives way to the rack, the choice strip appears over it

autoClose.rule: an empty trip and a broken Probe have no choice: at 2500 the arrival dithers back (frame.json idle wake transition, 180 ms) to the screen it came over

arrival.skip: any key during the show cuts to the show's end (✓, ← or the pad); a room key is Later, then it acts; reduced motion: every beat is a cut on its time, a mibi appears as a cut with no hop

report.plate: a plate set into the door's plain sage panel (GB-R6), the fix 2 kit's construction: a 1 px hairline, a 5 px sage bezel lit top left, the inner shade, a lit lip; no heading and no label plate (T-20261016-144); the rim and shade are painted; the face draws no fill, edge, top rule or shadow
report.noDigits: but beside a material icon, a pod icon or a price icon
report.words: at most 6 on the card, the goal line's (frame.json strings.goal.step.*); everything else is a picture or a mark; a figure stands only beside an icon

pods.more: past 8, 7 icons and +n, n = pods − 7, a figure beside the pod icons at the 8th place
pods.empty: no pods: one dashed empty pod outline at the first place

reach.thresholds: r = explored/of: below 1/3 one pip; 1/3 to below 2/3 two; 2/3 to below 1 three; explored ≥ of all four; of = 0 (a crate with no map): no map, no pips

crates.rows: the first three walk crates opened, one tile each; later crates get no tile; Gathered adds up every crate

gathered.note: Energy, Data and Essence icons, each with +n beside it

probe.paid: ⚡ and the Energy the plates cost, only when paid; mended free, the plates alone
probe.from: the dock's mend { free, paid, broke, spent } (state.mjs dockKey), kept in Cargo's UI state from the dock until the report: one plate icon for each plate mended, free or paid (a break is mended free); no mend, nothing at x 320. It is not in the save: a reload loses it, and the report then has no Probe

goal.when: goalKey (frame.json strings.goal) is not null, computed after the crates
goal.text: the goal row's content is the same strings.goal.step.* words and icons as Home's; a name too wide for its room with its icons falls back to the nameless sibling (props `plain`)

meanwhile.when: only when the goal's step is goOut, findPod, bud or short and goalKey's meanwhile is not null: the pod icon, the chapter's emblem (rail-emblem-{chapter}-unread-24x24; the star glints at its corner when the read is a glint) and the ◆ icon with the read's price

report.height: 16 + 64 + 16 + 24 + 16 + (goal ? 24 + 16 : 0) + (meanwhile ? 32 : 0): 136 without a goal, 176 with one, 208 with the read too; it never passes 208 ≤ maxHeight 288

panel.from: the Companion's dock, at the show's end (regions.arrival.end): the strip form
panel.closes: Later, ← or a room key: the arrival dithers back to the screen it came over, as it was; Open the bay: the strip goes and the opening runs

notes.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false; UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29): every step is a cut to its end. crateIn: the crates stand in their places on the frame of the dock, hold 0. The opening keeps its pace and its hold (crates × 3000 + 200): one crate every 3000 ms, each step at its time as a cut, because each crate's words, materials and world turn are read in turn; the report shows at the end. A press that ends an event with `cut: true` also acts (habitat.json notes.cut); no event here cuts. With props.motion false the host sends events.opening once at 0 (ms and hold unchanged) and stages each step as props at its time, crate k from k·3000: sealed at 0, open at 200 (no opening slice), ribbon 500, counters at their new values 800, pod i in its well at 1200 + 150·i, turn 1650; the report at crates × 3000. The face only cuts. Cargo's own steps are cuts with or without motion (R8).

crateIn.when: the Companion docks with crates while Cargo shows: the door opens as a cut on the Dock frame (R2) and each crate's shadow appears on its landing frame

beats.do: the bay shows (the screen's dither, 180 ms; on Cargo itself no transition)
the ribbon's words; the link light's first step; the first crate starts to slide
the band: the Probe's plates and who leaves
each mibi dithers in, then hops (regions.arrival.mibis)
one cut: the rack and the strip

show.rule: kind arrival, target show: the face's own clock reads the beats; ✓ Skip (any key) cuts to 3500; with reduced motion (props.motion false) the host stages regions.arrival.at at each beat's time and each is a cut

byCrates.rule: the host sends whole ms: crates × 3000 + 180 and the hold 20 ms longer, for 1 to 9 crates (hold ≤ 30000, lvgl-switch §2.7); in play at most 3. With 10 or more (developer only) the event plays the first nine; the rest are taken in by openBay, the counters and turn reach their final values at the end

opening.focus: the room; no ring; no key moves it

crate.do: a cut to this crate's closer, sealed, on the open bay (R8): no dither, no veil
the seal tag tears and the lid lifts: sealed → opening → open, its pods in their places
the ribbon shows this crate's words (a cut, no fade)
the counters tick this crate's materials (the top bar's own tick and flash)
each pod travels from the crate to its well (regions.travel), in well order; a pod with no free well stays in the crate
the world turn jumps to the crate's turn (the top bar's tick)

end.do: a cut to the report at crates × 3000: the door shut, the plate on it; the report stands still for the last 180 ms and the hold's 200

focus.room: the ring on nothing: Cargo has no targets; ✓ does the bottom line's action, the pad does nothing
focus.held: while events.opening holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent but room:<x> (kept by the host and dispatched when the hold ends), when the report shows. A Dock during the opening is kept by the host (by parity: two presses cancel) and acts when the hold ends, before a kept room key; it does not close the report card.
focus.report: while the report card shows, any key closes it and also does what it does: ✓ follows the bottom line, ← only closes it, the pad only closes it, a room key closes it and opens its section

confirm.bay: a crate ready to open (walk crates while docked, a ready sitting crate): the opening (events.opening); else nothing, no ✓ cap
confirm.report: See the new pod or See the new pods (strings.newPods): the jump to Pods (frame.json navigation.jumps); with no new pod, Done: the card closes

back.bay: Home, the ring on the Cargo module
back.report: closes the card: the door shut when the bay holds nothing, the waiting pods on the open bay when pods wait

keys.dock: the Caddy's Dock, a world event, never a Station key. Docked while the bay shows: the door opens (a cut) and the crates slide in (events.crateIn). Lifted while the bay shows: the door shuts (a cut) when the bay then holds nothing. During the opening it waits until the report shows. No message plate: the bay, the top bar's Companion mark and the context line say it. A refused Dock shows its plate.

crates.when: a crate is ready to open: walk crates while docked, a ready sitting crate docked or away
crates.subject: strings.subjects.crates (while crates slide in, the count of crates drawn: a crate counts from the frame its slide starts, i × 250 ms after the Dock; with reduced motion every crate is in on the Dock frame)
crates.need: the most pressing notice after the crates (home.json strings.needs)

bay.orderNote: pods waiting while away: the waiting line comes before the away line, because the bay is open and shows them; "the bay is empty" reads over the shut door (copywriter 02:16)

show.action: strings.arrival.skip while the show runs (any key skips to the choice)
show.subject: strings.subjects.crates, or strings.subjects.empty when none came

arrival.choice: the decision panel's strip form: ✓ + the focused card's name, the card's line, back Later (panel.json strings.dock)

opening.action: strings.skip while the hold runs (✓ Skip: a skippable hold, lvgl-switch.md §2.1, cuts to the report)
opening.subject: strings.subjects.opening

handoff.rule: a crate's pods land in the rack, the Station's six wells: Pods' collection shows them in the same wells, new until identified. ✓ See the new pods on the report jumps to Pods' collection with the ring on the pod that most needs the player; ← there reads Home. A pod with no free well waits in the bay (regions.waitingPods) and lands, oldest first, as a well frees

contrast.note: measured on the plate floor behind each row box, at 1×

arrival.broken: The Companion is home. Nothing came back this time.
arrival.rule: the ribbon at 20, the band words at 16; measured: "The Companion is home" and the broken line fit the ribbon (words + 32 ≤ 608), "three mended, free" ≤ 160; the choice strip's names and lines are panel.json strings.dock

subjects.waitingOne: a pod waits for a well

ribbon.rule: the crate only, no digits; the ordinal counts walk crates only (first, second, third; past the third, later, never from play); a developer crate reads like any later crate (Another crate home) and is not counted; the land's reach is on the report card

placeholders.bay: the signed masters cargo-bay-992x320 and cargo-bay-shut-976x304 (masters-pods)
placeholders.rack: cargo-rack-992x168: the insert; draws nothing until placed
placeholders.report: cargo-report-plate-560x128 to 560x288 by 8; draws nothing until placed
placeholders.reportDoor: cargo-bay-shut-report-976x304: draws nothing until signed (rule 4); the report has no label plate (T-20261016-144)
placeholders.shadows: crate-shadow-256x24, crate-shadow-432x24 and cargo-store-shadow-72x21: draw nothing until placed
placeholders.icon-pod-16: the report's Pod icon, 16×16: the signed master, shared with the Probe bench (masters-pods 5f04d417)
placeholders.icon-shield-16: the report's Shield icon, 16×16, one per plate mended (a lost plate is not shown): the signed master, shared with the Probe bench (masters-pods 5f04d417)
placeholders.cargo-crate-64x64: the report's crate tile picture, 64×64: the signed master (masters-pods 09edac93), painted at 64 from the bay's crate, not scaled
placeholders.icon-map-14x12: the report's map icon beside the reach pips, 14×12: the signed master (masters-pods 09edac93)
placeholders.icon-pod-empty-16: the report's dashed empty pod outline, 16×16, for a crate that gave no pods: a labelled placeholder until its master
placeholders.icon-probe-16: the report's Probe icon, 16×16, before the plates mended: a labelled placeholder until its master
placeholders.icon-arrow-16: the report's arrow mark, 16×16, bone, before the goal words: a labelled placeholder until its master
